# alpine-baselayout

`alpine-baselayout` is maintained in Alpine's `aports` repository
(`main/alpine-baselayout`); its sources are the files stored there (layout
files and scripts), and upstream publishes no separate license text file for
them. The Alpine recipe declares the package license as `GPL-2.0-only` (see
`APKBUILD-3.24-stable`). The standard GNU GPL v2 text is included as `COPYING`
(copied verbatim from `third_party/licenses/alpine/common/GPL-2.0.txt`).
